notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. OWNERSHIP: Devgan's 823,017 shares (as of the March 9, 2026 record date) include options exercisable within 60 days (footnote 4) and exclude LTP and relative TSR PSU awards still subject to performance vesting (footnotes 6 and 7). The holder figures come from Schedule 13G amendments with event dates of December 31, 2025 (Vanguard) and March 31, 2025 (BlackRock), divided by the March 9, 2026 share count of 276,092,068. DIVIDENDS: Cadence pays none. GEOGRAPHY: top-level regions as reported. The United States alone was $2.31 billion of the $2.48 billion Americas total, and China $0.68 billion of Asia. Rounded segments sum to 5.30. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow add-back ($455,175 thousand).

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM also holds Cadence corporate bonds, in a separate row that is not counted. CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (issuer name 'CADENCE DESIGN SYSTEM INC'). Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the 10-Q cover count at September 30, 2026 (stated as approximately 274,379,000), the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record are the 10-K's 'registered stockholders'.
